author: Astra, during the interactive implementation session
status: Exploratory hypothesis, not validated causal localization
observation: With bfloat16 inference, the initial four-task probe passed three functions but returned None instead of clipped boundary values on the clipping task.
prediction: Support-only low-rank updates to late MLP output matrices may improve clipping on new parameter values while preserving simple coding skills.
controls: Same rank, steps and rate at earlier MLP layers
falsification: No held-out coding improvement, a retention regression, or equal performance from the matched earlier location weakens the hypothesis. A successful edit alone does not identify a circuit.
